dedupe_keys.name: ukpvgeo solar panels and solar farms in the uk

description: UKPVGeo maps more than 260,000 photovoltaic installations across the United Kingdom, including small domestic solar panels and larger solar farms. The research team combines a crowd-sourcing campaign with other sources to improve geographic coverage of installed generation. Zenodo preserves the September 2020 release as a GeoJSON geometry file, a CSV point file and a short README. The repository explicitly applies the Open Database License, allowing free reuse subject to its terms. This is a fixed geographic release, not a live generation or deployment feed. The locations can support distributed-generation inventories, exposure analysis and photovoltaic forecasting simulations, complementing data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that the own description claims broad national coverage without establishing complete identification of every installation. Location data alone do not verify inverter capacity, operating status or electricity-network connections. The review opened the deposit metadata but did not download geometries, point records or the associated imagery sources.
